item.title: Sparkle Stories Podcast - "The Magician and the Knight" from the By Thistle By Thimble collection
item.description:
This week's featured story comes from the By Thistle By Thimble collection.

It's called "The Magician and the Knight."

This story is about Ellie and Arnold, two six-year-old twins who share a wonderful idea: what would happen if all the children suddenly turned into their Halloween costumes? What if the children dressed as wizards, tigers, scarecrows, and baseball players actually became wizards, tigers, scarecrows, and baseball players?

item.title: Sparkle Stories Podcast - "Sudden Story" from the Martin & Sylvia: Saturdays! collection
item.description:
This week's featured story comes from the Martin & Sylvia: Saturdays! collection.

It's called "Sudden Story."

During a visit to Grandma's, brother and sister are inspired by some street performers who create a "flash performance" in the park. They too want to tell a story publicly — and suddenly — without any announcement. When Momma suggests they tell a "sudden story" at Mrs. Brown's birthday party, Martin knows just the right story to tell...

item.title: What If World - Stories for Kids - 411. Farting Lobster, Burping Crab: Part 1
item.description:
When Derek the lobster and Kiwa the crab find out that New What City needs their help, they leave their sewer home and set out on a magical—and sometimes gassy—adventure.
Lessons include: Working together doesn’t always mean doing the same thing; we never need to make a big deal about farts and burps. It’s just a body doing what comes naturally.

item.description:

item.title: What If World - Stories for Kids - 410. Gavin asks: What if Fred could turn anything into sticks?
item.description:
When Fred wakes up in a stick-free meadow, he’ll do anything in his power to find something to chew.
Lessons include: Taking responsibility for our mistakes; listening to other people’s body boundaries (even when you’re a make believe dog).
This is the audio-only version of a YouTube video shot in front of a green screen for a kid-friendly, low-stimulation, no AI video. Grownups, you can find it via this link or by searching on YouTube Kids for What If World.
Note: While chewing on a big sturdy stick can be fun for a dog, don’t let them consume the pieces. And don’t let them chew on Oak, which is not considered pet-safe.

What If World - Stories for Kids - 409. Jackson asks: What if I turned into Godzilla and destroyed the city? (w/ Hamish Steele)
item.description:
On his first day of school, Jackson (played by Hamish Steele) gets turned into a giant monster! Will he crash through Mystak City or get sent to outer space?
Lessons include: Everyone needs an outlet for their big feelings; taking a little break in a big moment just takes a little imagination.
We are celebrating the release of Go-Man vs. the Star Dragon, the second in an amazing graphic novel series for kids featuring giant monsters, robots, super heroes, and more! These stories are funny, heartfelt, and action packed. Our kids love them and we hope yours will too. What If World - Stories for Kids - 154. Alice asks: What if Mr. Eric wasn't real? (Updated!)
item.description:
Poppa Loo’s News reports from a speeding train where people are turning into elements from the periodic tables! Can he and Mamma Jamma find Mr. Eric and help us get What If World back on track?
Lessons include: Researching a problem can help you fix it; keep thinking and observing to stay safe in a tense situation.
This episode has been remastered with new FX, cleaned up vocals, and new post-story activities! It originally aired on March 2nd, 2020.
